name: TreeSpark transfer diagnostic; infrastructure verification

target.workload: Existing Mooncake and agent-75; exact current manifests must be re-attested

baseline.status: historical user context, not re-attested live deployment
baseline.topology: H200 DP4/EP4 per four-GPU group; B200 target topology unresolved

instructions: Develop one useful bounded experiment for load-adaptive tree proposal or verification budget. Known techniques and ports are welcome. Identify hardware/model integration obstacles and strongest static comparator. Distinguish the two TreeSpark papers. Establish a service ROI model from exposed drafter + verifier + sampling cost per accepted token; numerical values must remain unknown unless given in source evidence. A reported benchmark gain is not our serving gain. Prefer a cheap diagnostic before changing live vLLM. No publication novelty requirement. Use only available source evidence; preserve missing deployment proof as explicit gaps.
constraints: No invented measurements or implementation support
